title: Mart's Group Peak Pack
description: Cozy vanilla plus modpack with systems like Create, Farmer's Delight, etc
body: A cozy-but-adventurous Fabric 1.20.1 pack built for long-term survival with friends. Explore richer biomes and seasons, build with a huge set of decor and furniture mods, and enjoy smoother performance and quality-of-life tweaks. Includes Create and many add-ons for automation, plus curated worldgen, mobs, and visuals for a lively, immersive experience without overwhelming complexity.
